_readme: Per-unit translation policy for en/. Keys: '<file>' (whole page) or '<file>#<section id>'. Values: translate (default) | localize (adapt Taiwan-specific content for a global reader; must add a 'Note:' callout) | transcreate (rewrite for the audience; sales.html) | rewrite (prompts that assume Chinese output) | skip (excluded; card shows 'Chinese only'). Anything not listed = translate.

sales.html.brief: Overseas edition: no TWD, no Taiwan-only framing, real contact channel; Option A (self-hosted) / Option B (managed by WoowTech). Prices, currency, CTA and contact channel are placeholders until the business brief arrives.

prompts.html.brief: Prompts must instruct the AI to answer in English; keep CLI/API/UI strings verbatim; state the true prompt count.

skills.html.brief: Full translation; any prompt demanding Traditional Chinese output becomes English-only.

ch7_node_types.html.brief: Generalize Taiwan-only SaaS examples; retain a visible Note explaining the regional adaptation.

ch8_first_workflow.html.brief: Replace fixed Taipei assumptions with instructions to select the reader’s IANA timezone; retain a visible Note.

ch10_triggers.html.brief: Replace fixed Taiwan/Taipei scheduling assumptions with a valid IANA example and globally applicable timezone guidance; retain a visible Note.

ch12_http_request.html.brief: Generalize Taiwan-market SaaS examples to regional services worldwide; retain a visible Note.

ch14_expressions.html.brief: Use a valid IANA example while telling readers to choose their own timezone; retain visible Notes.

ch15_if_switch.html.brief: Use a location-neutral sample customer; retain a visible Note.

ch18_set_function.html.brief: Describe name ordering and timezone behavior without assuming Taiwanese conventions; retain visible Notes.

ch19_subworkflow.html.brief: Rename the Taiwan-specific date formatter and require the organization’s chosen timezone; retain a visible Note.

appendix_settings_ref.html.brief: Replace fixed Taiwan/Taipei defaults and offsets with globally applicable IANA-timezone guidance; retain a visible Note.
